findings.title: Plugin request logs no longer include the trace ID
findings.body: This log entry used to append `traceID` from the request context, but that extraction was removed and the new contextual logger middleware adds only endpoint, plugin, datasource, and user attributes. As a result, completed plugin request logs lose trace correlation, making it harder to connect them to traces; preserve the trace ID in the log fields or add it to the contextual attributes.
